note: the scheduler and alerts, release notes and requests, impact tracking and backup, with their routes

areas.name: scheduler
areas.doc: The scheduler and change alerts: the schedule (off by default, since an automatic run spends tokens), the alerts and the email that sends them, the watch, the hourly watchdog, the nightly reconciliation and connector watch, and the loop that runs the paid audits and drives the stock bridge's send. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes are in gizmo/routes/scheduler.py. Read as `scheduler.NAME`.

areas.name: updates
areas.doc: What's new: the release notes that ship with the release (the repository's data/changelog.json), the app's version and start time, and the desk's own feature requests. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its route is in gizmo/routes/updates.py. Read as `updates.NAME`.

areas.name: impact
areas.doc: Impact tracking: a snapshot of the store's headline figures when a change is made, and how they have moved since, for the Impact list and the assistant. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its route is in gizmo/routes/impact.py. Read as `impact.NAME`.

areas.name: backup
areas.doc: Backup: the zip of everything restorable (credentials excluded), the weekly snapshots and their record. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes, the download and the restore, are in gizmo/routes/backup.py. Read as `backup.NAME`.

routes.name: routes_scheduler
routes.doc: The scheduler's routes: the schedule and the change alerts. Gathered from add_routes (stage 4 of the 14 October audit) where the first stood; their paths are literal, so no request changes hands.
routes.register_doc: Add the schedule and alert routes to the app.
routes.comment: The schedule and alert routes (gizmo/routes/scheduler.py), gathered where the first stood.

routes.name: routes_updates
routes.doc: The What's new route: the release notes, requests and what each person has read. Moved from add_routes (stage 4 of the 14 October audit) where it stood.
routes.register_doc: Add the What's new route to the app.

routes.doc: The impact route, moved from add_routes (stage 4 of the 14 October audit) where it stood.
routes.register_doc: Add the impact route to the app.
